scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.apk: npm run build && npx cap sync && node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');execSync(process.platform==='win32'?'gradlew.bat assembleDebug':'./gradlew assembleDebug',{cwd:'android',stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.apk:release: npm run build && npx cap sync && node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');execSync(process.platform==='win32'?'gradlew.bat assembleRelease':'./gradlew assembleRelease',{cwd:'android',stdio:'inherit'})"
